patthana23.11:1.1: Nakusalaṃ naparittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato paritto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā pañca.
patthana23.11:2.1: Nakusalaṃ namahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato mahaggato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.11:3.1: Nakusalaṃ naappamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
